text:
우리가 가지고 있는 생각 중에
하나 *바꿔야* 될 게 있다면
en: If there's one belief we need to change,

text:
"아 사람은 잘 안 *바뀌어*"
이런 거 있죠

en: "When the Holy Spirit comes on you, you will receive power
and be my witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria
and to the ends of the earth," it says.
If a demon gets in, a person changes.
The Holy Spirit came in. Why wouldn't they change?

text:
하나님 말씀을 읽을 때
예배를 드릴 때
en: when we read God's Word, when we worship.
When we expect God's Word to change us,

text:
그 삶의 기대감이 있을 때
변화됩니다

en: That's because we try to change by willpower.
